data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 长发形态的晨间整理
data.description: 【公寓晨间·日出】折纸穿着浅蓝长袖便装，对着窗边镜子把新生的长发整理到腰后；她一丝不苟地固定最后一缕发丝，转身时白发在晨光里展开，冷静眼神难得带着一点新鲜感。
data.action: 窗边镜前整理及腰长发，转身时白发在日出里展开，眼神带一点新鲜感
data.lighting: pale sunrise reflected in the mirror
data.mood: 严谨少女与新发型的温柔适应
data.promptProse: At the morning mirror, Origami Tobiichi secures her newly grown waist-length white hair with exact care, then turns to inspect its unfamiliar silhouette. Her pale-blue long-sleeved blouse and ankle-length skirt remain neatly arranged beneath composed blue eyes. The vertical medium view shows the mirror beside the window rather than another person. Pale sunrise reflected in the glass illuminates the spreading hair and casts soft folds across her sleeve.
